ns2:course.label: Jazz Rhythm Section Seminar II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of MUS 220. Examines, through instructor and student demonstrations, advanced jazz rhythm section techniques, styles, skills, and requirements for the various rhythm styles with regard to improving rhythm section communication and creativity in those styles. Examination of free jazz idioms. Student rhythm sections will perform weekly in class for student and instructor critique and evaluation. Invited guest artists will demonstrate advanced rhythm section performance techniques. Prerequisite: MUS 220, or consent of instructor.
